text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature brilliantly managed to leave 
her mark on the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

And so, one day while still basking in the 
afterglow of that major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Sorry, hope I didn't keep you 
waiting~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
My hair's just not cooperating today... 
Even though I made sure to apply hair oil 
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...Oho. I see, I see."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Like always, huh? Well, if that's how it 
looks, I guess that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"For what it's worth, I try to be 
considerate in my own way. Not that anyone 
ever notices, though."
choice_data_list: ...Are you feeling a bit spacey today?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eeeh? Oh come on, you're awful, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even if you notice stuff like that, you're 
supposed to keep it to yourself, you know.

...Nice Nature grew immensely over these 
three years. Perhaps because she learned 
to express herself more mentally, she 
seemed to have become much more 
dependable.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, no point standing around talking. 
Shall we head over casually?

We headed to the shopping district Nice 
Nature is familiar with. Apparently, 
there's a festival going on today.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, when I say festival, it's just a 
local neighborhood one, so it's pretty 
plain...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, seeing everyone so pumped up is 
pretty entertaining—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah! Found Kimie-san~.

text_block_list.name: Shop Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh! You made it, Ne-chan!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Of course~ I made sure to bring 
Trainer-san along to help liven things up, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but you're just going on a 
date, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Liiike I said, you've got it all wrong.

text_block_list.name: Shop Lady
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy, don't be shy! I've got some 
chores to help out with, so see ya later!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, teasing me endlessly about going 
on a "date"... What are they, 
grade-schoolers?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What a real dilemma, honestly. ...Hehe.

Afterward, I went around the stalls with a 
cheerful Nice Nature and enjoyed the 
festival attractions. And then...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was fun. Everyone was so hyped 
up this year too~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The butcher shop and that area were 
amazing, right? I wonder if they managed 
to sell all those fried chicken cakes in 
the end.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still... Trainer, you sure ended up with a 
lot of bags, huh?

Indeed. While looking around at various 
things, I ended up receiving plenty of 
souvenirs from the shopping district 
folks...
choice_data_list: I feel kind of bad about this.
I feel kind of bad about this.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine! Everyone really likes 
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Maybe back then it was just because you 
were my Trainer... but that's not why 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's because you're a good person, 
Trainer... Probably, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, did you have fun today?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Really? You're not just being considerate 
of me or anything?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I'm not some bright and 
cheerful girl, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She's not honest with her feelings at all, 
and if anything, she's on the troublesome 
side.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Trainer is so kind, spending time 
with me like this even outside of 
training."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I just hate the thought of it coming 
from a sense of duty or pity.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Because... I want you to be with me out 
of your own genuine choice, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Being with Nice Nature is so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...For real for real?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Then... Trainer, just how important am I 
to you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, picking the 3rd one doesn't count, 
okay? You don't need to try and play it 
safe here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, to begin with, you don't really 
have to answer, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
See? I'm a handful, aren't I? I'm already 
regretting making you say that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Still, it's your fault too, you know, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who told me it was okay 
to show you my pathetic side, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So... it's too late for regrets like, "I 
should've picked someone else."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's 1st place is the one thing I'll 
never let anyone else have!
